names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 9819, «Феодор (Лебедев), иерей, сщмч.», with the rank words left off. This is not the folder `theodore-lebedev`: that man is name page 9406, «Феодор (Лебедев), протоиерей, сщмч.», an archpriest shot on 25 September 1937 and kept on the Julian 12 September. The calendar holds two priests of this name and separates them by rank and by day — иерей against протоиерей, and 25 September/1 November against 12 September — so this folder is disambiguated by the day its name page lists, 1 November, and no row claims the two are one man.

feast.note: The day commemorates the finding of his relics, which the calendar's day line dates to 1985: «Обретение мощей сщмчч. Александра и Феодора пресвитеров (1985)». His name page marks this day «(обретение мощей)» and lists two others, «26 января (Новомуч.)» and «1 ноября»; one row per church is the schema, so those are recorded here and he does not render on them. The 1 ноября line was read on 4 October 2026 and it gives the year of his death, «(1918)», which this folder now carries; nothing else about him is printed there and the row stays on the day it was written for.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 25 сентября ст. ст. — «Обретение мощей сщмчч. Александра и Феодора пресвитеров (1985).»

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru prints at the end of the line it names him in on 1 ноября ст. ст., «Сщмчч. Александра и Феодора пресвитеров (1918).» — the same pair, under the same two grades, as the 25 сентября line this folder's row rests on. It also tells this folder's Theodore from the archpriest of the Julian 12 September, who is dated 1937 on his own day. The calendar carries no life page for him on either day and prints no year of birth.
